_comment: What each clip of the sound-test capture is. `?` means nobody has said yet — the same convention as descriptions.json for sprites. Clip numbers are the files in assets/audio/sfx/, which `npm run split-audio` regenerates from the capture; nothing here is derived, it is all knowledge that only a person listening has.
